_note: MATADJUST runtime (laneDATA4). Applies the matAdjust rows of the 'source' json (hdrp_fixes.json) to the loaded materials at runtime, so a rock facet / clutter tint / colour / smoothness / normal edit is a HOT data copy instead of a scene chain. Absolute values (same as HdrpFixes), so a material that already has them (baked by the chain) is left untouched. enabled:false or this file missing = the code does nothing.
_rowsNote: optional extra rows with the same fields as hdrp_fixes.json matAdjust (match, color, normalScale, tiling, metallicMax, smoothnessMax, smoothnessMin, aoStrength, emissiveScale); applied AFTER the source rows, so they win.
